grants.footer: Each row sets this person's own Grant; where a group gives more, the Machine goes by the higher. Counts from their next Turn. You can change only Agents you manage, while their Machine is online.
grants.none: You manage no Agent, so you cannot change what they hold

remove.footer: Every device key of {{name}} stops working, and their Grants and Triggers stop. Invite them again with a new link.
remove.title: Remove {{name}}
remove.body: {{name}} can no longer give work to any Agent. Tasks they made stay on the Machine.

title: People
footer: Everyone in the Workspace. Owners have every Agent. Tap someone who joined with a link to see or change their access and title.

groups.heading: Groups
groups.footer: A group grants everyone in it at once

role.label: Title
role.footer: Shown after the name on every device; grants nothing. Only an Owner or the person themself changes it.
